hits.title: Quality Assurance in Call Centres: An Ultimate Guide | Dialpad
hits.snippet:
## What is quality assurance (QA) in a call centre or contact centre?

Quality assurance (QA) is a process that ensures your products or services are meeting the standards you’ve put in place. Through continuous monitoring and evaluation, organisations can identify any problems or gaps in service and take necessary actions to improve. [...] In call centres and contact centres, managers use QA to maintain consistent and high-quality customer service. This involves monitoring every interaction between agents and customers, to assess overall call quality, agent skills, and compliance.

The data gathered from customer service quality assurance helps you to measure performance against key metrics, and use it to improve not just customer experiences but also operational efficiency. [...] Call centre quality assurance helps you assess how you’re doing, and see what you need to do to improve. It’s a continuous process of monitoring and evaluating customer-agent interactions and using the data to identify problems and opportunities.
